title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name Duvet Cover
description:
Embrace your love for baseball with this personalized bedding set from Jeminise. This comforter set combines comfort with a passion for the game, making it an ideal gift for baseball players and fans alike. Customize it to make it uniquely yours or a thoughtful present.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features custom name options to create a unique and special bedding set.
  • Thoughtful Gift: Perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, suitable for various occasions like Valentine's, Mother's, Father's Day, and Christmas.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with microfiber filling for a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight experience.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin, US Full, US Queen, and US King sizes to fit different beds.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, can be air dried without heat for quick drying and fluffiness.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Environmental protection techniques are used in the finishing process to prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, with pillowcases also available.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber Filling
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Theme Baseball
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Special Feature Breathable
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
